narrative_text: Complainant reports that a break-in at commercial premises took place within MH-KOL-04 police station limits, Kolhapur, between 01/01/2021 02:54 and 01/01/2021 09:30. It is stated that the accused left no sign of tools, targeted a godown, appear to have had inside information, came on a two-wheeler, were two or three persons, got in by lifting the shutter, ransacked the place, struck early in the morning, fled on a two-wheeler and struck while the premises were closed for the night. A spot panchnama was drawn up in the presence of witnesses. It had been raining heavily that evening.
